title: Firmalife: Better Chromium
description: An ultra-tiny datapack which reduces the size of Chromite veins to more realistic ones and allows crafting of Chromium and Stainless Steel plated blocks.
body:
This ultra-tiny datapack for Firmalife reduces Chromite amounts in veins from ungodly to acceptable, as well as allows the creation of Chromium and Stainless Steel plated blocks.

Chromite vein changes are **only applied to newly generated chunks**, same as with any worldgen update/datapack/mod.

Discord link leads to the official TerraFirmaCraft server.

**Note: This datapack is a jury-rigged fix until EERussianguy (Firmalife creator) does something about it, since I have zero knowledge about Java.**

---
